Name: Main WiFi Controller
Description: ESP32-S3 development board with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and USB-C for power and programming. Handles sound processing and LED control.

Name: RF Front-End Module
Description: Integrated RF Front-End Module (FEM) with Power Amplifier (PA) and Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) to extend Wi-Fi range to 500m+.

Name: 5V Voltage Regulator
Description: Second stage for logic power, stabilizes to 5.0V.

Name: 3.3V Voltage Regulator
Description: Low Dropout 3.3V Linear Voltage Regulator.

Name: Power Status LED
Description: Indicator for medium heat setting.

Name: WiFi 2.4GHz Status LED
Description: Indicator for high heat setting.

Name: WiFi 5GHz Status LED
Description: LED to indicate network activity (data transmission).

Name: Mode Selection Button
Description: Provides physical input for manual control or configuration of the smart switch.

Name: Enclosure Bottom Half
Description: 3D-printed bottom half of the enclosure with integrated standoffs and mounting points for main PCB and components. Designed for USB-C and button access.

Name: Enclosure Top Half
Description: 3D-printed top half of the enclosure with integrated light pipes for LEDs and space for graphene antenna elements. Designed to snap or screw onto the bottom half.

Name: PCB Standoff for Main MCU
Description: Custom 3D-printed standoff integrated into the bottom enclosure for mounting the main MCU board.

Name: RF Module Mount
Description: Custom 3D-printed bracket for securing the RF front-end module within the enclosure.

Name: 2.4GHz Antenna Mount
Description: Custom 3D-printed fixture to securely hold the 2.4GHz graphene antenna within the top enclosure half, optimizing signal path.

Name: 5GHz Antenna Mount
Description: Custom 3D-printed fixture to securely hold the 5GHz graphene antenna within the top enclosure half, optimizing signal path.

Name: USB-C Jack Retainer
Description: Small 3D-printed part to retain the USB-C power jack securely against the enclosure opening.

Name: Mode Button Actuator
Description: 3D-printed plunger-style button to extend the mode selection button through the enclosure for user access.

Name: M2x6mm Mounting Screws
Description: Small M2 screws for securing the main PCB to integrated standoffs and the enclosure halves together.

Name: Power Status LED Mount
Description: Front-bezel mount for the Power Status LED with a flush face and rear standoffs for the PCB. Cable relief on the bottom.

Name: WiFi 2.4GHz Status LED Mount
Description: Front-bezel mount for the WiFi 2.4GHz Status LED with a flush face and rear standoffs for the PCB. Cable relief on the bottom.

Name: WiFi 5GHz Status LED Mount
Description: Front-bezel mount for the WiFi 5GHz Status LED with a flush face and rear standoffs for the PCB. Cable relief on the bottom.
